verdict.rationale: Devin's CLI docs say Adaptive automatically routes each prompt to a model, and that users can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with the /model command. This directly matches the story. However, the evidence is a single sentence scoped to the CLI. missing for 10: list of selectable models, evidence that model choice is available in the web app or cloud sessions or as an org-level setting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice

citations.quote: You can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model.
Adaptive is an intelligent model router that automatically selects the best AI model for each task.
